en-US.description: A full-featured desktop app for Hermes Agent.
en-US.longDescription:
A full-featured desktop app and web dashboard for Hermes Agent.
Manage AI chat sessions, monitor usage & costs, configure platform channels,
schedule cron jobs, browse skills — all from a clean, responsive web interface.

zh-CN.description: Hermes Agent 的全功能桌面应用
zh-CN.longDescription:
Hermes Agent 的全功能桌面应用和 Web 管理面板。
管理 AI 聊天会话、监控用量与成本、配置平台渠道、
管理定时任务、浏览技能 —— 全部在一个简洁响应式的 Web 界面中完成。
zh-CN.name: Hermes Studio

- fix session search matching by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2145
- feat: add cursor-based session compression by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2146
- fix(workflow): allow scoped Coding Agent protocol overrides by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2154

- Add profile-scoped skill bundle commands by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2156

- make windows desktop frame square by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio/pull/2167
